decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed two-storey side and rear extension, due to its size, position and wraparound design, would represent an obtrusive and overbearing development which would harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers by reason of enclosure, loss of light and loss of outlook, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed extension, due to its size, position and appearance, and when taken with the existing outbuilding at the site, would represent an overdevelopment of the site, which would fail to be secondary to the original proportions of the house and would harm the character of the house and street scene, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Erection of two storey side and rear extension to house incorporating 3 windows to side roof slope.
